A worn and incomplete early-medieval silver penny of Eadwald of East Anglia ( c. 796-798/800), new unlisted type. Uncertain mint, moneyer EADNOD. Obverse: Beaded short wheel cross, two pellets in each angle. Pellets and trefoil of pellets between certain letters Legend: +EA(D)WALD.REX. (W and L upside down).
